· 5-day / 20-day High-Low Pattern (Sideways): no trend reversal signal confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.08x): normal level, indicating moderate confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): no clear directional bias, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
